questions.question_text: Evaluate the socio-economic significance of the Amul cooperative model created by Dr. Kurien.
questions.correct_answer: The Amul model revolutionized rural India by shifting power from exploitative traders to milk farmers. By organizing village dairy cooperatives, farmers secured fair prices and year-round demand. The profits financed community health, education, and animal husbandry. Furthermore, it proved that Indian farmers could manage world-class enterprises, laying the foundation for national self-reliance in food production.
